selection_rule: held-out family-arm compounds (arm == 'family' in family_deployed_pooled.csv; family constant fitted without the compound, on its leave-one-out fold reference) whose reference curve has >= 5 distinct temperatures spanning >= 300 K; the 3 with the lowest held-out family error
protocol: per-family SHAPE_NOCAP calibration held out: c_family_loo, p_family_loo from compute_deployed_route.py, scored on family_calibration.fold_pairs(compound)
not_representative: the three BEST fits by construction; the full per-compound distribution is family_deployed_pooled.csv
